description: This file defines a mock logger class for testing purposes within the OrangeHRM system. It extends the main Logger class and utilizes the Monolog TestHandler for capturing log messages during tests.

classes.name: MockLogger
classes.description: A mock logger class for testing, extending the main Logger class and providing access to the TestHandler instance.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the MockLogger by calling the parent constructor with a test channel name and a TestHandler.

methods.name: getTestHandler
methods.description: Returns the TestHandler instance used within the logger for inspecting logs during tests.
